bottleneck.description: Industrial overhead crane and port-equipment maker; #3-4 European share, competes with Liebherr, Terex, Cargotec, ZPMC.

dependency.key_customers: Steel mills, ports, automotive plants, paper mills, warehouse/logistics customers
dependency.key_suppliers: Steel structures, motors, drives, control electronics vendors

editorial.notes: Konecranes is a credible global player but holds only ~15-20% of European industrial crane share with substantial competition from Liebherr (~35% EU share), Terex/Demag, and Chinese players (XCMG, Zoomlion, ZPMC). Crane procurement is cross-shoppable and substitutable.
